ticket.summary: Only toilet in home is fully blocked, water sitting at rim, two plunger attempts failed; no backup at other fixtures — needs auger clearing, booked first priority slot 8 AM.
mitigation_advice: Closed the toilet's supply shutoff valve (oval handle on supply line at wall, clockwise until snug) to prevent overflow [PB-01]
ticket.customer_message: You're booked: 8:00 AM tomorrow (Tue Sept 1) at 5 Coppersmith Ave — first slot of the day, flagged urgent since it's your only toilet. Keep the supply valve closed until the tech arrives; you'll get a heads-up text when he's on the way. $149 flat rate for the clog clearing, and he'll tell you before doing anything that costs more.
